entities.name: Jan Hus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Czech theologian and reformer (c. 1372–1415) who criticized Church corruption and advocated for reform a century before Luther. Burned at the stake at the Council of Constance, his death sparked the Hussite Wars.
